investigation_notes.Description: An encoded PowerShell command was executed as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM on WKSTN-RND-07 and decodes to a script that attempts to add a hosts file entry mapping update.microsoft.com to 195.54.224.28. The execution was initiated by powershell.exe with parent process cmd.exe and used an encoded (Base64/UTF-16) command, which combined with the SYSTEM context and hosts modification is anomalous and consistent with malicious intent. VirusTotal community reputation for the process hash is negative with more community 'malicious' votes than 'harmless', and a recent fodhelper.exe execution by a.vargas occurred minutes earlier, increasing the likelihood this activity is unauthorized; therefore this alert is classified as High Priority.
investigation_notes.Decoded Script Summary: The decoded command targets %windir%\system32\drivers\etc\hosts and attempts to add a hosts entry mapping update.microsoft.com to 195.54.224.28, with logic to handle file attributes and write the entry only if not already present.
